The '''Churba sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] included [[Lelmra]], [[Storthus]], [[New Cov/Legends|New Cov]], and [[Churba]] itself. The [[Peregrine's Nest]]'s final location was also in this sector.

==History==
[[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent [[Kirtan Loor]] hailed from the planet Churba.

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Churba sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] incorrectly places [[Allyuen/Legends|Allyuen]], [[Anoat/Legends|Anoat]], [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], [[Deyer/Legends|Deyer]], [[Gentes/Legends|Gentes]], [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], and [[Tokmia/Legends|Tokmia]] in the Churba sector rather than the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]]. ''Rebellion'' also mistakenly places the Churba sector in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].
